summary: A center seeking a counting waiver has to show what its sample can do beside its present method.
realLife: The 2023 Maine LD 1909 committee amendment proposed a temporary waiver conditioned on a statistically valid sample at least as accurate as the center's current method.
gates: A waiver application proposes a sample instead of scanning every container.
